description: “A strong economy should be measured not only by how much wealth it produces, but by whether working families can afford the necessities of life, see their wages rise with their productivity, build savings instead of debt, afford a home, invest in their future, and pass something of lasting value to the next generation.That is the purpose of a New Square Deal for Arkansas.”

title: A New Square Deal for Arkansas
